# Service Icon Sources

Twelve monochrome service glyphs are imported from Simple Icons contributors,
revision `17cd4ee07612198a1d8777a060d4100423762a8b`, under [CC0-1.0](LICENSE.md).
Pinned raw URLs, original brand sources and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in
`catalog/icon-sources.json`. The maintenance importer uses an XML parser and
only accepts the expected SVG title/path structure.

Canva uses an NMKING-created C monogram, not the Canva logo. Each glyph or
identifier is placed on a white square tile for consistent light/dark visibility.
Each installed package contains its own final SVG and source notice; rendering
does not need another plugin or an external image server.

All service names and trademarks remain their respective owners' property.
These identifiers do not make NMKING's guides official provider plugins or imply
provider endorsement. CC0 does not waive trademark rights.
